messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Hosted API (us-east-1) p99 latency spike detected. Queue length rising. Auto-provisioner reports repeated instance creation failures. Dashboard: https://redwood/dashboard/incidents/4123456789
laura: paging on-call (sam) - looks bad in #prod-metrics, p99 tripled, clients timing out. :rotating_light:
sam: on it. grabbing ops window now. can someone drop the quick metrics?
mona: current numbers from the dashboard -> queue length: 18,300 reqs; p95 ~4200ms; p99 ~9800ms; GPU pool util 99.2%; failed instance creations in last 10m: 27.
sam: thx. @devon can you pull autoscaler logs and check leader state? suspecting scale loop stall.
devon: looking. running: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler -c leader --since=15m```
devon: tail shows repeated: "ERROR leader: failed to acquire lease: context deadline exceeded" and then "WARN autoscaler: skip scaling, no leader" - looks like leader election lag.
azach: quick note - we also have provisioner rate-limits in cloud console for this account. the autoscaler keeps retrying instance creates but cloud API returns 429 / quota_exceeded which combined with leader thrash stalls recovery.
sam: ok two-fold: 1) leader election flapping causing controller to stop making scale decisions, 2) cloud API quota is causing instance creation failures. need short-circuit.
laura: customer impact - some large customers hitting timeouts. CS already getting tickets: several timeouts and increased error rates. ellie-cs, what's the immediate customer-facing status?
ellie-cs: already informed top-10 customers via status page and emailed affected contacts. engineering note will be posted in status soon. Customers reporting 504s. severity: P1 for impacted customers.
sam: mitigation plan (short): 1) force a leader restart to re-elect quickly, 2) fallback traffic routing for heavy jobs, 3) manual spin-up of reserved GPUs where possible, and 4) request quota bump to cloud. assigning roles: devon restart leader, zach manual scale and quota request, laura notify comms, sam coordinate overall.
devon: running leader restart: ```kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/autoscaler-leader```
devon: waiting... pods restarting. logs now show leader election success: "INFO leader: lease acquired by pod/autoscaler-leader-7f5c"
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout completed for deployment/autoscaler-leader in 22s.
sam: nice. check if autoscaler resumes actions and whether provisioner still failing.
azach: manual scale attempt: ```gcloud compute instances create --count=4 --machine-type=a2-highgpu-1...``` getting back: "ERROR: quotaExceeded: requested 4 GPUs, available 0". Cloud is rejecting. I opened a quota support request and submitted justification (req #CS-83472).
infra-bot: note: provisioner shows backoff loop when cloud API returns 429. current backoff window 30s -> will keep retrying.
mona: even with leader back, queue still growing because instance creation is blocked. p95/p99 still high: p95 3800ms, p99 7600ms.
sam: we need immediate relief for customers: option A - divert traffic for large batch requests to lower-capacity model variant; option B - enable graceful throttling for non-enterprise customers. thoughts?
laura: recommend option A for now, because it preserves enterprise SLAs. patch routing table to send models with token_count>2k to fallback model-small.
devon: patch in progress: ```PATCH /routing/weights -> set model-small weight 0.25 for traffic-tag=batch-heavy``` will apply via console.```Applying now...```
ops-bot: routing service updated. model-small receives 22% of batch-heavy traffic.
ellie-cs: posting status update: "Investigating elevated latencies in us-east-1. Mitigations underway: routing some heavy jobs to fallback models. We will update within 30m."
sam: additional mitigation - enable ephemeral reserved GPUs from dedicated pool (we have some capacity in reserved region) - @zach can you reassign 6 GPUs from dedicated pool us-east-reserved -> hosted-temporary?
azach: doing reassignment via internal tool: ```/infra/transfer-gpu --from=us-east-reserved --to=hosted-temporary --count=6``` got: "transfer started" -> but note: these are admin-only ops and will transiently affect reserved tenants. alerted infra and execs.
ops-bot: provisioner picked up 6 new nodes. instance creation logs: "INFO node-provisioner: node added gpu-aux-104" and new capacity visible.
mona: immediate effect visible: queue down to 9.2k, p95 1800ms, p99 3200ms. still elevated but improved.
sam: good. keep monitoring. devon, can you grep autoscaler logs for any additional errors? also collect leader election timeline for postmortem.
devon: grabbing logs: ```kubectl -n infra logs deploy/autoscaler -c leader --since=1h | grep -E "leader|error|lease" -n``` snippet: "00:03:12 ERROR leader: failed to renew lease: resource temporarily unavailable" then "00:03:45 INFO leader: lease acquired by pod/autoscaler-leader-7f5c" then later several 429s from cloud API. saving log bundle to /tmp/4123456789-autoscaler-logs.tgz.
sam: thanks. ellie-cs what do we tell customers now?
ellie-cs: latest status posted. noting that we've rerouted heavy traffic and added temporary capacity; impact reduced but some customers still seeing intermittent 504s. ETA for full recovery: 45–90 minutes while queue drains.
laura: tagging on-call EU for handoff when US shift ends in 30m: @oncall-eu please stand by for handoff.
sam: summary/actions: - Leader restart (done) - Temporary routing to fallback (done) - Transferred 6 GPUs from reserved pool (done) - Quota request submitted (in progress) - Postmortem assigned to devon + zach + ops (owner: devon)
zach: filing follow-up: create runbook entry to detect leader election lag earlier, add circuit-breaker for instance creation 429s to prevent long retries, and default fallback routing when queue > 5k for 5m.
laura: comms note: schedule a more detailed update in 30m and a follow-up postmortem to customers who were impacted.
ops-bot: incident-bot: severity downgraded to P2 - service partially degraded, mitigation in place.
mona: metrics now: queue 4.1k, p95 920ms, p99 1500ms. errors decreased.
sam: good work. continue monitoring next 2 hours; owners: devon/zach for postmortem. handoff to oncall-eu in 28m. any other blockers?
ellie-cs: CS inbox quieting but will escalate any new reports immediately.
devon: will upload logs and timeline to the incident ticket: https://redwood/incidents/4123456789/postmortem
laura: closing remarks: root cause hypothesis = autoscaler leader election lag combined with cloud quota-induced instance creation failures -> provisioner retry/backoff led to slow recovery and queue growth. mitigation = leader restart + fallback routing + manual capacity transfer; long term items: leader hardening, quota monitoring/auto-request, and circuit-breaker for provisioner.
sam: thanks team. please add any remaining notes to the ticket. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident recorded and assigned to devon for postmortem. Timeline captured.
laura: handing off to oncall-eu now. :headphones: "
